title: How to power ANYTHING using USB-C Power Delivery and the ZY12PDN PD Trigger Board
summary: Kenneth Finnegan shows how USB-C Power Delivery trigger boards like the ZY12PDN negotiate 5V to 20V so you can power projects from a USB-C charger, including the color coding for each voltage.
why: Recommended as a practical way to get 12V or other voltages from USB-C for hobby projects.

quote.text: These little boards are ultra handy
